questions.subject: Programming skills · Design
questions.text: A museum kiosk needs to explain three exhibits. Which plan is easiest to test?
answers: One labeled button for each exhibit
Three unlabeled buttons with changing meanings
questions.explanation: Explicit labels and responses give each interaction an observable purpose.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Design
questions.text: A project explains how weather sensors help gardeners. Which feature supports that purpose?
answers: A reading display linked to a watering recommendation
A hidden score with no explanation
questions.explanation: The feature connects the displayed measurement to its practical use.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Design
questions.text: What should a tester know before checking an interaction?
answers: The input to try and the expected response
The number of files on the device
questions.explanation: A test compares a specified action with an expected result.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Design
questions.text: A visitor cannot find the reset control. Which revision addresses the feedback?
answers: Add a visible control labeled Reset
questions.explanation: A visible descriptive control makes the action discoverable.
